warning.titlePre: Land Rover Freelander eD4 Injector & DPF Issues
paragraphs: Freelander eD4 engines with the Ford Duratorq 2.2-litre diesel commonly show injector failure and DPF clogging over time. We replace the injectors, EGR valve and timing belt as standard on every Duratorq rebuild.
